albedo.note: No Imagine JPEG was generated for this candidate. Albedo is authored linear ice, snow, and cold rock in glacier/albedo.js. It is not recoloured to pass CIE76. The blocking gate compares the shader albedo times the dawn rig with the SwiftShader pixel.

light.note: One rig for every material. Same record shape as a night-light.json. Ambient, sun, and sky are set once.

proceduralSky.note: Colour is a function of world direction. The same direction stays within 0.015 across cameras and screen positions. A screen-space sky is the negative control and must fail.

bolt.note: Usual live bolt439 card, centred, meadow follow distances. Not a new dog.
